en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a neo‑Gothic / neo‑Romanesque church with a very tall, steep central spire rising from an octagonal tower. The church stands in a landscaped square or small park with trees and paths around it. Surrounding the church are late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century brick and stucco buildings, including a large institutional-looking block on the left and an industrial building with a tall chimney on the right. The sky is left blank/overexposed, and there is a wide street with lamps and fences in the foreground. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.
